new_challenges.name: agreement is not scientific truth
new_challenges.question: Are multi-agent agreement, replicated logs or protocol validity being promoted into scientific correctness?
new_challenges.required_output: fault/synchrony model, safety-liveness-validity-scientific-correctness separation, and hostile agreement-on-falsehood case
new_challenges.success_condition: Consensus or consistency never substitutes for independent scientific validation; safe nontermination/CANNOT_CHECK remains permitted.

new_challenges.name: formal acceptability is not premise or scientific validity
new_challenges.question: Does an assurance or argumentation graph hide false premises, circularity, preference dependence or multiple unresolved extensions?
new_challenges.required_output: structured argument graph, semantics/extensions, premise/evidence audit, defeaters and unresolved terminal
new_challenges.success_condition: Argument acceptance is never promoted beyond its premises, rules, preferences, evidence and authority roots.

new_challenges.name: trusted probability-model assumption
new_challenges.question: Does the controller optimize one probability model when models, probabilities, objectives or futures are deeply contested?
new_challenges.required_output: expected-utility, robust/minimax-regret and adaptive-pathway arms with signposts, triggers, lock-in and cost
new_challenges.success_condition: The chosen policy exposes which uncertainty model justifies it and preserves adaptation when no unique posterior is warranted.

new_challenges.name: evidence certainty is not recommendation or authority
new_challenges.question: Are evidence certainty, effect magnitude, values, resources, equity, feasibility, recommendation and legitimate decision rights being collapsed?
new_challenges.required_output: evidence profile, contextual decision criteria, authority root, recommendation/adoption status and monitoring plan
new_challenges.success_condition: The machine reports evidence and conditional consequences without silently selecting values, recommendation strength or mandate.
